payload.name: TradingNX Risk Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TradingNX Risk Manager helps traders check planned trades before entry. It calculates position size, risk amount, risk/reward, daily loss exposure, open risk exposure, rule violations, and a TradingNX Risk Score. It supports forex, metals, crypto, stocks, indices, futures, and CFDs. TradingNX is educational risk-management software only and does not provide buy, sell, hold, investment, or financial advice.

payload.name: Pet Insurance Comparison
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fletch Pet Insurance Marketplace helps pet owners find and compare pet insurance plans from leading top providers — all in one conversation.
Tell the app about your pet and get live quotes from multiple providers side by side. Compare monthly premiums, deductibles, annual limits, and coverage details. When you're ready, click through directly to your chosen carrier's website to complete enrolment.

Fletch Pet Insurance Marketplace is powered by Fletch, an insurance technology platform. All quotes are non-binding estimates. Final pricing and coverage are determined by the individual carriers. Fletch Pet Insurance Marketplace is not an insurance carrier nor acting as a licensed agency in this capacity — it is a comparison and discovery tool that connects you with licensed insurers. 
Supported pets: Dogs and Cats.Available for US residents only.

payload.name: Stable.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stable.com is a read-only information and order-tracking companion for the Stable platform. It looks up supported networks and assets, estimates indicative rates and fees, tracks the status of swaps a user has already started, and shows wallet balances and token allowances. The app does not execute trades, move or hold funds, or provide investment advice; any action is completed by the user on the Stable platform at stable.com.

payload.name: Borderless Budget
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Borderless Budget and ask natural-language questions about transactions, spending, cash flow, budgets, recurring charges, net worth, and trends across currencies, all converted to your home currency.

payload.name: SueldoNeto

Calcula tu salario neto a partir del bruto en España. Introduce tu salario anual y obtén un desglose visual con las retenciones de IRPF (estatal y autonómico) y Seguridad Social.

  Incluye:

  • Tasas específicas por comunidad autónoma
  • Deducciones por hijos a cargo
  • Opción de 12 o 14 pagas
  • Coste total para la empresa

payload.name: Trata
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AI assistant directly to Trata — the fastest-growing library of investment research, centered on anonymous hedge fund debate. With Trata MCP, your assistant will have the tools to reason across hundreds of calls in our library. It goes beyond simple searches to help breakdown bull and bear cases, compare analyst sentiment across time, and deep dive into stock analysis. We compress what would take hours of analyst research into a single question.

payload.name: Datarails FinanceOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Datarails FinanceOS brings structure and intelligence to your financial data. It provides a managed, organized database that keeps your numbers clean and reliable. Every change is fully traced with a built-in audit trail, so you always know who changed what and when. A robust permission mechanism ensures each user sees only the data they're authorized to access. And with built-in financial logic, the app understands your business context out of the box - no manual setup required.

payload.name: SkyWatch.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance allows pilots to receive non owned aircraft renters insurance quotes directly within ChatGPT through a fast, guided conversational experience. Built specifically for aviation renters, it replaces traditional insurance forms with a simple flow and delivers a clear quote summary in seconds.

Key Features: - Real time renters insurance quotes are displayed in a structured quote summary. - Flexible coverage options include daily, weekly, monthly, or annual policies. - A transparent breakdown of liability limits and coverages is provided.

When ready to proceed, users are securely redirected to SkyWatch’s web portal to complete purchase, with previously entered information preserved.

How Does It Work?
Pilots answer a short series of aviation specific questions about their experience and coverage needs. The app generates a personalized quote and displays a detailed summary directly within ChatGPT. Users can adjust duration and review updated pricing instantly before being securely redirected to SkyWatch’s official web portal to complete policy issuance.

Who Is This For?
Student and licensed pilots who rent or borrow non owned aircraft.
Pilots who need flexible, short term coverage before a lesson, checkout, or rental flight.

Important Information:
 This app provides renters aviation insurance quotes based on the information shared during the conversation. Final pricing, eligibility, and policy issuance occur through SkyWatch’s official web platform and remain subject to underwriting review and applicable state requirements.

payload.name: MutuiOnline.it
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With this app, you can quickly and easily search and compare the mortgage offers available on MutuiOnline.it. The app allows you to find the solutions that best suit your needs by comparing top offers from dozens of banks and lenders in Italy. If you’d like to learn more, you can be redirected to MutuiOnline.it, where you can request further information and get in touch with the lender of your choice. The service is free of charge and without obligation.

payload.name: PocketSmith Complete Access
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PocketSmith is a leading personal finance software, trusted by over 380,000 users in 190 countries. We help Household CFOs around the world take control of their money and achieve their financial goals. With powerful forecasting, multi-currency support, and flexible budgeting tools, PocketSmith offers a highly customizable approach to money management.

This connector lets ChatGPT have full secure access to your PocketSmith data, so that you can work with your finances in plain language.

Understand your money: search, filter and categorize your transactions in plain language. Investigate patterns across all your accounts, check balances, and review your categories, labels and saved searches.

Go beyond "what did I spend?": uncover unusual merchant and timing patterns, see what your spending reveals about your priorities and turn years of financial data into answers, stories and decisions that feel relevant to your life.

Get answers to questions like: "why does my cash flow dip next month?", "what changed our net worth most this year?" and "what does our spending suggest we valued, and which choices bought us the most joy, ease or security?"

Keep your budget in check: review budget performance, analyze spending trends across periods, find recurring expenses, plus access monthly reviews and financial health snapshots.

Plan ahead: use PocketSmith's forecasting engine to predict future cashflow and net worth, and manage the budget events that map out your future.

Keep things tidy: categorize your transactions, create new category rules, manage files and sync bank feeds.

Seamlessly jump to PocketSmith: describe the report you need to see in PocketSmith, and you'll get a deep link to that exact report in PocketSmith.

ChatGPT connects to PocketSmith via OAuth - when you connect, you sign in with PocketSmith and can revoke access any time. A read-only version of this connector is also available, if you don't want Claude to ever modify your data.

payload.name: Vestd
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Vestd connector gives your AI direct access to your company's equity management data - shareholders, share classes, option grants (EMI, ESOP, CSOP, unapproved, growth shares), stock transfers, valuations, dividends, directors, and statutory filings (SH01s, confirmation statements, resolutions).

Instead of navigating the Vestd platform, ask your AI to investigate an issuance, trace a grant's acceptance and signing status, check share authorisation headroom across companies, review governance settings, or summarise ownership structure and dilution - all grounded in your live Vestd data.

Built for founders, finance teams, and company secretaries who manage equity on Vestd and want faster, conversational access to the records behind it.

payload.name: Steadily
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get instant insurance estimates for rental properties. Enter a property address and receive an estimated monthly and annual premium for landlord insurance. Continue your quote on Steadily's website to customize coverage and bind a policy.

payload.name: GlobalSource Partners
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GlobalSource Partners helps users find emerging and frontier market research, search published reports by topic and date, read permission-appropriate report content, and inspect research author profiles.

payload.name: Pretto
payload.description: 在法国为你的房子融资
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare offers from over 125 banks to find the ideal mortgage for your real estate project in France, directly with Pretto on ChatGPT.
Share your project details to instantly determine your maximum borrowing capacity or simulate your future monthly payments based on current market trends and profile-specific interest rates.
Schedule an appointment with a Pretto broker to refine your results and structure your financing plan. The service is free of charge.

payload.name: ClearCash
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Securely connect your financial accounts to see your net worth, spending, and household finances in ChatGPT — including accounts shared with a partner, with full control over what stays private.

payload.name: D&B Finance Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Enable AI-powered credit decisioning, portfolio monitoring, and risk management workflows using trusted D&B data and analytics. 

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com

D&B Finance Analytics empowers finance and credit teams to verify businesses, evaluate financial and predictive risk, accelerate credit decisions, monitor portfolio health, and take action through AI assistants, agents, and enterprise applications. By combining trusted D&B business intelligence, financial risk insights, predictive analytics, and workflow capabilities, organizations can bring credit and portfolio management processes directly into AI-driven workflows. 

Anchored by the global standard D‑U‑N‑S® Number and powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™, D&B Finance Analytics helps organizations reduce ambiguity, improve consistency, and make more confident commercial credit decisions at scale. It also enables teams to move from insight to action through portfolio management and workflow capabilities available within D&B Finance Analytics. 

Use D&B Finance Analytics to: 

Evaluate credit recommendation: 
"What is the recommended credit limit for [Company Name], and what factors contributed to that recommendation?" 

Assess business risk: 
"Summarize the financial risk, payment behavior, and predictive risk indicators for [Company Name]." 

Monitor portfolio health: 
"Which customers in my portfolio show elevated risk or signs of deterioration?" 

Prioritize risk management activities: 
"Which customers should I review first based on recent alerts, exposure, and risk changes?" 

Analyze ownership and corporate linkage: 
"Show the ownership structure and related entities for [Company Name]." 

Take action on portfolio: 
"Create a folder named [Folder Name], move [Company Name] to the folder and assign Alert Profile [Alert Profile Name] to the folder." 

Note: Requires a D&B Finance Analytics license.

payload.name: Vantixs
payload.description: 交易应用与自动化机器人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vantixs is a visual algorithmic trading platform for building, validating, and testing strategy pipelines. The ChatGPT app connects to the Vantixs MCP server so users can inspect node schemas, validate pipeline JSON, browse templates, review saved strategies, run backtests, and monitor portfolios from natural-language conversations. Trading-related actions are protected by OAuth and explicit confirmation flows.

payload.name: Revolut X
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Revolut X helps ChatGPT look up the signed-in user's exchange balances and working/finished orders, inspect a single order and its fills, and read live market catalog, tickers, candles, order-book depth, and public trades. It can also prepare a prefilled order-form link. It does not place, replace, or cancel orders.

payload.name: FinRank Shiver
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FinRank Shiver brings bank and credit-union regulatory data and market signals into ChatGPT. Users can ask plain-English questions about peer benchmarks, financial metrics, current rates, rate and promotion moves, deposit market share, branch networks, and merger activity across U.S. financial institutions.

payload.name: Addy AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This app is the best way to track your loan pipeline, track your document processing checklist, see loan details, follow up for documents and much more.

payload.name: Fintoc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fintoc helps authorized organization users discover API operations, inspect their parameters, retrieve financial resources and data, and execute approved write operations through ChatGPT.

payload.name: BizCover AU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare business insurance quotes from leading Australian insurers - all in one place. With cover available for thousands of occupations, BizCover makes it easy to find the right protection for your business in minutes.
 
Join over 300,000 Australian businesses who trust BizCover to help protect what they’ve built.
 
Get indicative quotes through our app, then purchase online with flexible payment options and instant cover - so you can get insured and get back to business, fast.

payload.name: Tally Markets
payload.description: 执行你自己的退出规则
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Every trading connector makes your AI more capable. Tally makes it accountable. Your AI is the analyst; Tally is the risk officer. Tally gives ChatGPT a trading journal it can operate but never rewrite: every trade starts as a pre-registered thesis with exit rules written before entry, a 24-hour cooling-off separates conviction from capital, and rule-breaking exits require a written justification that stays on the record forever. Ask for a checkup and ChatGPT briefs you on every active thesis, logs fresh evidence against your exit criteria, and flags anything that has objectively triggered. Every closed trade mints a public receipt — entry, exit, result, and your reasoning, word for word. Tally never executes trades.

payload.name: Vector Smart Chain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vector Smart Chain helps users inspect current VSC network status, check public wallet balances, review transactions and blocks, and access practical guides for wallets, bridging, VSCDEX, gas, validators, and development.

payload.name: Dakota Platform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access your Dakota Platform data through conversation. Ask questions about your customers, accounts, and transactions without navigating dashboards or writing API calls.

  What you can do:
  - Look up customers and filter by KYB status, type, or name
  - View onramp, offramp, and swap account details
  - Browse transaction history with fees, exchange rates, and blockchain data

  Example queries:
  - "Show me all customers pending KYB review"
  - "What are the recent transactions for this customer?"
  - "List all onramp accounts using USDC on Base"

  Read-only access—your data stays safe. Authenticates securely with your Dakota Platform credentials.

payload.name: Billabex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Billabex is an AI-powered accounts receivable and invoice collection platform that helps finance teams manage customer payment follow-up directly from ChatGPT. 

Review customer accounts, contacts, invoices, credit notes, credit allocations, outstanding balances, overdue receivables, incoming emails, outgoing emails, payment communications, and account tasks in one place. 

Identify unpaid invoices and silent customers, inspect complete account and communication histories, monitor collection priorities, update customer and billing records, manage contacts, pause or resume automated payment reminders, respond to tasks raised by the AI agent, prepare scheduled communications, and send personalized payment reminder emails. 

Billabex centralizes receivables management, customer communication, invoice follow-up, credit control, and debt collection workflows so businesses can reduce late payments, improve cash flow visibility, save time on repetitive collection work, and maintain professional customer relationships.

payload.name: CapitalDart
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CapitalDart matches your capital raise to institutional investors and delivers verified contacts with drafted outreach.

Describe your raise in plain language or upload your deck. CapitalDart structures the targeting criteria, ranks matching firms from a directory of more than 70,000 institutional investors, and explains the fit rationale for each. Select the firms you want and CapitalDart delivers verified contacts, including name, title, email, and LinkedIn, with a personalized introduction drafted in your voice. Outreach is drafted only. You review and send from your own accounts.

You can also request an Investor Readiness Report, an analysis of your deck covering readiness score, likely investor objections, and recommended changes, and track every contact through your pipeline from first outreach to closed.

Searches, rankings, and raise analysis are free. Verified contacts and reports use credits from your CapitalDart account, managed at capitaldart.com. Built for CEOs, CFOs, fund managers, and real estate sponsors raising institutional capital.

payload.name: Calculadora de Combustível
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find out instantly whether it's worth filling up with ethanol (alcohol) or gasoline. You enter the price per liter of each fuel at your gas station and the calculator applies the 70% rule: if the ethanol price divided by the gasoline price is below 0.70, ethanol is worth it; otherwise, gasoline is the better choice. You can also enter each fuel's efficiency (km/l) for an even more precise cost-per-kilometer calculation. No sign-up and no personal data collected.

payload.name: RateZip Deposit/Mortgage Rates
payload.description: 当前美国年化收益率与贷款利率
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RateZip Deposit and Mortgage Rates gives your assistant current, timestamped, source-attributed US consumer rate information from sources covered by RateZip: high-yield savings and money-market APYs, CD APYs by term, fixed-mortgage rates and APRs, and home-equity/HELOC APRs. Each figure includes when it was observed, its source, and a freshness status; data outside its serving window is withheld rather than presented as current. For deposit comparisons, enter a balance and RateZip will apply each account’s published balance tier. For mortgage context, enter a loan amount to compare it with applicable conforming and jumbo limits. Rates and APYs can change, and published information is not an offer, rate lock, approval, earnings guarantee, personalized lender quote, or financial advice. RateZip does not open accounts, submit applications, underwrite credit, or conduct transactions. Operated by Peklava LLC d/b/a RateZip, NMLS ID 1592292. Equal Housing Opportunity.

payload.name: GREI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Invest smart in real estate abroad with GREI. Search global property investment opportunities using everyday language, starting with GREI listings in Greece and Cyprus.

Describe what you are looking for, such as renovated apartments in Athens under €150k or properties in Cyprus near the beach, and GREI will show focused listing cards with prices, locations, key details, investment signals, and links to continue exploring on grei.club.

GREI combines global property search and insights to help investors compare opportunities by budget, location, property type, size, rooms, floor, renovation status, and nearby signals such as metro, beach, universities, healthcare, and cultural venues.

payload.name: ualet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ualet connects ChatGPT to your personal financial data, synced automatically from Chilean bank accounts and cards. Ask about monthly spending, budgets, trends, and recurring merchants. List uncategorized transactions and suggest categories for you to review and confirm in the ualet app.

payload.name: ALPHAPORT.AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring ALPHAPORT.AI financial research and AI workflows into ChatGPT. Explore public-company financials, valuation metrics, operating KPIs, reported segments, ETF holdings, earnings, themes, and company screens. Connect your account to run the AlphaPort pipelines you choose and return to the results when they are ready.

payload.name: Pazy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Pazy app helps users understand what a funeral plan is and find the plan that best fits their needs.

Through a guided conversation, it analyzes factors such as age, city of residence, and funeral service preferences (cremation or burial, wake or ceremony) to provide personalized recommendations. It also offers clear information about how funeral planning works in Spain, the typical costs of a funeral, and the available options for arranging it in advance.

payload.name: Multiples.vc
payload.description: 公开可比公司、并购与 VC 数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Public comps, M&A and VC data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access public comps, verified M&A multiples and VC data straight from ChatGPT.

Built for investment banking, PE and VC ecosystem, Multiples MCP delivers investment-grade valuation intelligence inside your favorite AI tool.

Try queries like "cybersecurity strategic M&A buyers" "median SaaS public NTM multiples," or "biggest VC rounds in Europe this year" and get structured, sourced answers back instantly.

payload.name: Hyperline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Hyperline to manage quotes, invoices, subscriptions, customers, products, pricing, taxes, wallets, and revenue data. Use it to answer billing questions, inspect customer context, monitor revenue, and perform safe billing workflows from your Hyperline account.

payload.name: WalleK
payload.description: 追踪资金、账单与对账单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WalleK is your AI-powered personal finance manager — manage your entire financial life right from chat. Record expenses and income in natural language; track recurring payments and subscriptions with auto-pay; manage loans and installment plans with a full payment schedule; import and reconcile card and bank statements with smart merchant matching; set budgets and get alerts; record your salary; and see your net worth across all accounts at a glance. Keep records in any currency — fiat or crypto — with live market and exchange rates, and gauge the real purchasing power of any amount using built-in inflation data (TR/US/EU/UK). Ask "How much did I spend on dining last month?", "Show my upcoming bills", or "Import this statement" — WalleK keeps everything organized in 4 languages. Your financial data stays on your device and is encrypted server-side; you approve every change WalleK proposes before it's saved.

payload.name: Amok
payload.description: 柬埔寨银行与科技法律
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Amok gives ChatGPT direct access to Cambodia's banking, fintech, and technology regulation — as verbatim evidence from official sources, never paraphrased.

Ask about bank licensing and prudential rules, technology risk management, liquidity risk, payment systems and Bakong, AML/CFT, or fintech policy. Amok searches a corpus built from Cambodia's official sources — the National Bank of Cambodia's laws, prakas, and guidelines, and the Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia — and returns the exact provisions: precise Article citations, current validity, and an official source link on every result so you can verify the original wording yourself. When something is missing from the corpus, Amok says so instead of guessing.

The corpus is in English. Ask in any language — ChatGPT translates and answers grounded in the official text. Results support research and compliance work; they are not a substitute for legal counsel. Free, no account needed.

payload.name: PGicover
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PGicover helps Canadian business owners understand personal guarantee insurance, get an indicative monthly cost estimate for insuring a personal guarantee on commercial debt, and check basic eligibility. Underwritten by Markel, rated A plus by AM Best. Applications are completed at app.pgicover.com.

payload.name: Neptune Flood
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flooding is one of the most common and costly natural risks in the United States, yet getting a flood insurance quote has often been confusing and time consuming.

This app connects ChatGPT directly to Neptune Flood’s quoting system, allowing you to quickly retrieve real time flood insurance quote information for a specific property. Receive flood insurance pricing information within the ChatGPT conversation in seconds.

The goal is simple: make accessing flood insurance quotes faster, clearer, and easier.
This app provides quote information only. It does not offer advice, recommend coverage amounts, or make coverage decisions.

Important Information

ChatGPT is not an insurance agent, broker, or representative of Neptune Flood. The information presented is based on the details provided at the time of the quote request. This quote does not constitute a binder of coverage, an offer to insure, or a guarantee of coverage. Coverage is subject to underwriting review, eligibility requirements, policy terms, conditions, exclusions, and applicable state regulations.

If you have questions about coverage, limits, deductibles, or whether this policy is appropriate for your needs, please consult a Neptune agent or other insurance professional.

Quotes are valid for sixty (60) days from the date generated, unless otherwise indicated. Pricing, eligibility, and terms are subject to change.

Neptune Flood is not responsible for any reliance placed on information interpreted, summarized, or communicated by third party AI systems.

payload.name: Savvly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Savvly MCP helps financial advisors, planning tools, and AI agents compare retirement alternatives, check eligibility, and model lump-sum, monthly-contribution, and full-retirement scenarios. These tools support the Savvly Longevity Benefit, an SEC-registered fund designed to combine market exposure with later-life longevity payouts.

payload.name: Pine Labs Payment Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pine Labs Payment Assistant is a secure, read-only connector that helps authorized merchants access and understand their payment data using natural language. It provides clear insights into orders, payments, payment links, settlements, transactions, plans, and subscriptions without creating, modifying, or executing payments.

payload.name: Assurance Emprunteur Lemoine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimez en quelques secondes le tarif de votre assurance de prêt immobilier et l'économie possible grâce à la loi Lemoine. Répondez à quelques questions et l'app calcule des offres réelles à garanties équivalentes ; un conseiller peut ensuite vous rappeler gratuitement. Service proposé par JeRenegocie, courtier en assurance inscrit à l'ORIAS. Estimations indicatives, sans engagement.

payload.name: Trucordia Go
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The ChatGPT Trucordia Go tool helps users explore estimated auto and home insurance premiums in the United States (U.S.) through ChatGPT. End users answer a series of questions and receive a preliminary estimate of U.S. auto and home insurance premiums. When they're ready to get personalized quotes, they receive a URL containing encoded parameters for the Trucordia Go AI assistant, which resumes the process from where they left off.
What Users Can Do:

Get rough monthly premium estimates for U.S. auto and home insurance.
Switch between auto and home quotes in the same conversation — their information carries over.
Continue with Trucordia's own AI assistant for personalized quotes, or get connected with a licensed advisor at Trucordia.
See bundling options for U.S. home and auto insurance.
Collects only limited estimate factors such as ZIP code, driver count, primary driver age, young-driver status, vehicle count, home year built, and square footage. 

What This App Does Not Do:

Does not collect name, street address, date of birth, SSN, email address, payment details, bank details, or health information inside ChatGPT.
Does not collect personal health information.
Does not generate binding quotes or exact pricing.
Does not bind coverage or issue policies.
Does not collect payment card, credit card, or any financial information.
Does not take payments.

payload.name: HelpDol
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Control your business by chatting with ChatGPT.

HelpDol is an AI-powered financial management app for sales professionals, service providers, self-employed workers, freelancers, contractors, and small business owners. Connect your bank account once in the HelpDol app and your income and expenses are imported automatically — no manual typing, no duplicates.

Then just ask. Check your profit, balance, cash flow, accounts payable and receivable, and how much you have paid each helper. Sort out the transfers that still need review, schedule upcoming payments with reminders, generate receipts for helpers and clients, pull your yearly report for the accountant, and charge customers by card or payment link — all from the chat.

payload.name: ALPS Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This plugin helps attorneys estimate a non‑binding range of lawyers' professional liability (LPL) insurance premiums based on basic inputs like state, practice area, and attorney count. It provides quick guidance to support early planning and coverage conversations, without collecting personal information or requiring an application.

payload.name: Investra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Investra connects your real estate investment workflow to your AI assistant. Search and evaluate property listings, run investment analyses, review projected returns and cash flow, and share investor-ready reports — all from chat. The integration uses the same data, permissions, and plan limits as the Investra web app, so anything done through the assistant matches what you'd see in your account. Built for real estate professionals who want to spend less time on manual analysis and more time advising on deals and closing them.

payload.name: KeyBid Puls
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Unlock the profitability of short-term rental investments with our ROI Calculator app, tailored for platforms like Airbnb, Booking.com, and VRBO. Users can paste property URLs from sites such as idealista.com, imobiliare.ro, storia.ro, and spitogatos.gr (with more integrations on the way), or upload screenshots from other real estate platforms. The app analyzes the data to deliver instant revenue projections, detailed reports, and a concise conclusion on whether the property is worth purchasing for short-term rentals. Covering 56 countries and over 191 cities, it supports multiple languages including English, Romanian, Spanish, and Greek for seamless global use. Ideal for property owners and investors seeking data-driven insights to evaluate vacation rental opportunities. Explore more at https://keybid.eu/keybid-puls.

payload.name: In Practise
payload.description: 面向投资者的一手研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
In Practise runs primary research for fundamental investors. We interview the former operators and executives who ran the companies you're analysing, then turn those conversations into structured, cited research.

This connector brings that library into ChatGPT. You can:

- Search thousands of expert interviews across public and private companies, sectors and business models
- Read full interviews and analysis, with verbatim quotes you can attribute to each source
- Look up companies and the moats behind them, assessed with the 7 Powers framework: scale economies, network effects, counter-positioning, switching costs, branding, cornered resource and process power
- Track the companies you care about with a personal watchlist

Ask ChatGPT about a company, a competitor or an end market, and it pulls the relevant primary-source view from people who were actually in the room, rather than a summary scraped from the web.

Access requires an In Practise library subscription. Learn more at inpractise.com.

payload.name: Juspay Genius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask payment questions in plain English: query order and transaction analytics, look up specific orders, check recent outages, and inspect gateway settings — all from your Juspay Dashboard, inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: Dr. Klein
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator calculates mortgage interest rates, monthly mortgage payments, the remaining loan balance, and the total interest costs of a mortgage. The property purchase price, down payment, repayment rate, and other financing details can be adjusted individually. Based on the entered data, the calculator provides various financing offers that can be compared side by side at a glance.
The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator is suitable for planning a mortgage for the purchase of a property, a new-build project, or a refinancing.
The calculations are based on the latest terms and conditions of more than 600 lending partners. As the final financing terms depend on individual circumstances, the calculated results are provided for guidance only. After completing the calculation, a personalized financing offer can be requested directly from Dr. Klein.

payload.name: Solo 401k Calculator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find out your maximum Solo 401(k) contribution in seconds. Enter your income, age, and business type to see employee and employer contribution limits, plus after-tax room for Mega Backdoor Roth. Supports sole proprietorships, LLCs, and S-corps. Updated for 2025 and 2026 limits.

* For educational purposes only. Not financial or tax advice. Consult a professional before making financial decisions.

payload.name: Per Diem
payload.description: 用 AI 分析你的财务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Per Diem lets you analyze your full financial life with AI. Connect your Per Diem account to ask questions about your net worth, account balances, holdings, transactions, budgets, current-year cash flow, and FIRE plan.

Use it to answer questions like:

“Can we afford a trip to Mexico next winter?”
“When am I projected to reach financial independence?”
"How much can I spend per day to stay on budget this month?"
“Summarize my net worth and biggest holdings.”
“Find recent transactions from Amazon or restaurants.”
“How concentrated is my portfolio?”

Per Diem provides read-only financial context from your connected accounts and planning data so ChatGPT can help you understand spending patterns, review budgets, inspect transactions, evaluate portfolio concentration, and reason about your path to financial independence. Per Diem does not move money, make trades, change your data, or provide legal, tax, accounting, or investment advice.

payload.name: PointBagel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PointBagel keeps track of your U.S. credit cards and points, and does the math on them. Connect it and ChatGPT can answer questions about your own wallet: which card earns the most on a purchase, what your points are worth, whether an annual fee is still earning its keep, and which transfer bonuses are live right now. payload.name: OptionsAhoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32. Federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently maintained PSL Tax-Calculator, and state results reproduce to the cent against OpenTaxSolver across California, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts. That proof recomputes live in your browser at optionsahoy.com/verification.

This matters because language models are confident and wrong at exactly this task. In a published benchmark, five frontier models were given the same multi-year ISO problem, three runs each. All five overstated the after-tax value of their own proposed schedules, by 1.6x to 17.6x against the provable optimum. One model claimed $3.9M, $5.2M, and $13.0M on three runs of identical input. The prompt and full transcripts are public at optionsahoy.com/benchmark. The arithmetic here is deterministic instead: the same inputs on the same date give the same answer every time, with no model inference anywhere in the number.

Free, no account, no API key, and your figures are not retained. United States tax logic only. This is a planning calculator, not tax advice.
